name: Sakura Biyori
source:
Ronji Mizushima failed to pass entrance exams and moved to Sakura Heights boarding house to study as ronin. He chose this place because the rent was cheap and landlord was a beautiful woman. It turned out that it was inhabited only by women and thus his life in an apartment full of women begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
水岛丈二入学考试落榜，为了复读备考，搬进名为“樱庄”的膳宿公寓。他选择这里，是因为房租便宜，房东又是一名美女。没想到，住户竟然全是女性。就这样，他在女人堆里的公寓生活拉开帷幕。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vndb-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
